headline: Good News: Prices of Several Basic Necessities Fall, West Java Experiences 0.05 Percent Deflation | Republika Online
summary: Prices of several basic necessities fell in West Java, producing 0.05% deflation. The decline is attributed to the harvest season.
why: Consumer price data shapes central-bank policy and household purchasing power, which matter for Indonesian rates and consumer stocks.
